name: dsh-projects
description: Project and session organization for DeepSeek Harness: multi-folder projects, attention summaries, grouped chat search, and native folder picking.
longDescription: Organizes native DSH Workspace and Session data without migrating existing chats. Includes optional multi-folder project groups, compact or expanded attention summaries, grouped project/title/indexed-conversation search, pinning, favorites, manual ordering, an archive center, light/dark theme support, and native folder picking with a Web fallback. Alpha release — Windows Desktop is the primary real-world verified environment; macOS, Linux, and Web UI feedback is welcome.
